title: Project-first onboarding, safe Issue import and reproducible installation
acceptance_criteria: A validated writable repository-linked Project and complete status mapping precede every new Issue import
Repeated setup preserves private connections, board options and Issue identities; unresolved create outcomes never trigger a second create
Bootstrap forwards explicit GitHub setup before harness persistence or launch, with a read-only dry run
README and AGENTS document clean-clone setup and distinguish shipped capability from the remaining autonomous development backlog
Live Project contains existing backlog and accepted tasks without duplicates, with native sub-issues and implementation milestones
Independent spec, development, test, exact-head PR and exact-main postmerge acceptance precede automatic Issue24 closure
